geometry: 64 interior independent uniform volume points conditioned on N in the 3+1 Minkowski diamond, then add its two timelike tips. Reuse 0.2.0 RAX sample_diamond_points, CausalSet and link_matrix. One order per holdout case. Labels randomly permuted.
calibration: For each independent training order use unit pure E and pure B fields in each of x,y,z; average D2,D3 over the three orientations then over all qualifying training orders. Fit two response columns with no intercept, no adaptive thresholds or tuning.
blind: Generate fresh master entropy only after protocol, generator and estimator freeze. Independent RNG substreams for training, challenge geometry, orientation/amplitude, class shuffle, relabelling/local gauges and random case IDs. Store gold labels separately and hash blind data, calibration and answer key before the separate prediction process. Hash predictions before unblinding. Release entropy and key for reproducibility. Single-team procedural blind.
field: Pure E or pure B with equal case counts, independent isotropic 3-direction, uniform magnitude in [0.55,1.35]. Constant fields. Link transport exp(i*x.F.y/2) on straight embedded cover links, independently rephased at every vertex. No coordinate, seed, class, direction or magnitude in the predictor input.
features: All tip-to-tip Hasse paths of exactly k=2 or 3 links. For each family Dk=sum(abs(P-mean(P))^2)/(npaths-1), equivalent to mean(1-cos phase difference) over unordered distinct path pairs. Require >=2 paths in BOTH families, otherwise abstain and count a miss for every acceptance gate.
estimator: Solve calibration matrix C*[E2,B2]=[D2,D3] with no clipping. Score Jhat=E2-B2 against J=E^2-B^2=2*L_Maxwell in natural units (-+++); Jhat strictly positive -> E, strictly negative -> B. Zero -> abstain. Fixed diagnostic baseline D2>1e-16 -> E, otherwise B; no score for missing paths. Do not use baseline to replace the signed estimator.

gates.rule: For each of the four binomial counts (two targets, two true classes) form lower/upper exact Clopper-Pearson limits with per-side alpha=0.01/8. PASS if lower >= target, FAIL if upper < target, otherwise HOLD. Both classes must pass each target for that gate to pass. Conditional on frozen calibration.

safeguards: Require det calibration !=0, condition number <=1000, >=90% qualifying calibration orders. Stop for violation. Independent direct loop-pair oracle, random local phase and relabel invariance required. Any failed or abstaining blind cases kept. Test labels remain concealed through prediction; no retry for an undesirable result.
